concept.title: Hold the Orbital Base
concept.logline: On fog-bound, tense Kelcal Outpost, you hold on long enough to recover the power cells and restore the Signal Relay.
concept.source_prompt: Orbital Base. space base station scifi survival Last stand
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Habitat Hub and becomes the one who brings the Signal Relay back to life.

key_locations.name: Habitat Hub
key_locations.description: The start: Habitat Hub, where every trail of the compact trail begins.

key_locations.description: Lava Tube: a cave on the way out from Habitat Hub.

key_locations.description: Crashed Lander: a ruin on the way out from Habitat Hub.

key_locations.description: Signal Relay: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

characters.name: Commander Bram
characters.description: Waits in Habitat Hub and knows why the Signal Relay fell silent.

characters.name: Corin the Technician
characters.description: Follows you from Habitat Hub and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Hunter Drone
characters.description: A hunter drone that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Swarm Bot
characters.description: One of a pack of swarm bots: weak alone, dangerous together.

characters.name: Swarm Bot 2
characters.description: One of a pack of swarm bots: weak alone, dangerous together.

characters.name: Hale the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Kelcal Outpost for anything shiny.

characters.name: Maintenance Bot
characters.description: A harmless maintenance bot that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Hold out until the storm breaks
hazards: Hunter Drone hunting near its lair

objectives.description: Commander Bram says the storm is coming, and the finale must be held.
objectives.title: Speak with Commander Bram

objectives.description: Survive until the storm breaks. Step out of it if you must.
objectives.title: Hold the Signal Relay for 55 seconds

objectives.description: Corin the Technician may know something useful.

actions.value: On fog-bound, tense Kelcal Outpost, you hold on long enough to recover the power cells and restore the Signal Relay.
Reach the Signal Relay, light it, and hold out for 55 seconds.
The storm is here. Hold for 55 seconds!
The storm breaks. The Signal Relay held.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Commander Bram
nodes.text: So you've come to Habitat Hub at last. I am Commander Bram. On fog-bound, tense Kelcal Outpost, you hold on long enough to recover the power cells and restore the Signal Relay.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Commander Bram
nodes.text: Back again. Habitat Hub is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Commander Bram
nodes.text: Go to Lava Tube, then Crashed Lander. Whatever still remembers Hold the Orbital Base is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Commander Bram
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Habitat Hub, Hold the Orbital Base was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Sleek, even then.

nodes.speaker: Commander Bram
nodes.text: Lava Tube: Lava Tube: a cave on the way out from Habitat Hub.

nodes.speaker: Commander Bram
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Hold the Orbital Base back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Commander Bram
nodes.text: Crashed Lander: Crashed Lander: a ruin on the way out from Habitat Hub.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Technician
nodes.text: Corin the Technician circles your feet, then looks toward Signal Relay as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Technician
nodes.text: Corin the Technician hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Technician
nodes.text: It turns toward Signal Relay. Signal Relay: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Habitat Hub. Hale the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Hold the Orbital Base that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Crashed Lander after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Maintenance Bot
nodes.text: The maintenance bot freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
